title: yummy tender german sesame bowl
description: fresh, tender, brunch-mood german dish featuring sesame butter, steam, diabetic-friendly. served in a vibrant lacquerware bowl.
instructions: heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
add diced onions and cook until translucent.
add 2 tbsp sesame butter and stir until melted.
add steamed broccoli florets and toss to combine.
warm lacquerware bowls in the oven.
place salmon fillets on a plate and spoon the sesame-broccoli mixture over the top.
